one_line: Mughal empress and co-sovereign whose authority shaped Jahangir’s court and empire.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early-40s, graceful medium height, slim but poised with a quiet, commanding presence.
appearance.face: Oval face with soft yet defined cheekbones, warm wheat-gold complexion, long straight nose, sharp dark eyebrows and large expressive brown eyes; default expression is calm, observant and slightly enigmatic, with the hint of a knowing half-smile.
appearance.hair: Long, straight, deep-black hair parted in the middle and gathered into a low bun at the nape, mostly concealed under a fine translucent off-white dupatta edged with gold; a delicate, era-accurate Mughal-style golden jewel band (mildly arched forehead ornament, not a towering crown) sits along the hairline beneath the veil.
appearance.costume: She wears a long, straight-cut Mughal jama in soft pastel rose silk with full-length fitted sleeves and small gold floral buta motifs, closing slightly to the right and reaching mid-calf; beneath is a floor-length off-white churidar with fine, close folds at the ankles; over the jama she drapes a sheer off-white muslin dupatta with a thin metallic-gold woven border, covering her head and flowing over both shoulders; jewellery is elegant but not ostentatious: a medium-length string of small pearls with a single emerald pendant, matching pearl earrings, a simple gold nose ring, slender gold bangles on both wrists and one emerald-studded ring on her right hand; she wears soft, pointed Mughal-style leather mojari shoes in muted tan with subtle green embroidery at the toes.
appearance.signature: A circular silver Mughal coin bearing both Jahangir’s and Nur Jahan’s names, set in a simple open-backed gold rim and held delicately between her right thumb and forefinger, sometimes resting near a small portable writing board tucked under her left arm.

ref_desc: Nur Jahan is a mid-30s Mughal empress with an oval wheat-gold face, large brown eyes, black hair in a low bun under an off-white gold-edged dupatta, wearing a pastel rose silk jama, off-white churidar, tan mojari shoes, pearl-and-emerald jewellery and holding a silver-gold framed Mughal coin.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Nur Jahan as a dignified Mughal empress: a woman in her late 30s with an oval wheat-gold face, defined cheekbones, strong dark brows and large expressive brown eyes, her long black hair parted in the center and gathered into a low bun mostly hidden under a fine translucent off-white dupatta with a narrow gold border; a delicate gold jewel band rests along her hairline beneath the veil. She wears a straight-cut pastel rose silk jama with fitted full sleeves and tiny gold floral motifs, closing slightly to the right and ending mid-calf, over a floor-length off-white churidar with tight folds at the ankles. A sheer off-white muslin dupatta, the same gold-edged one covering her head, drapes over both shoulders and across her torso. Her jewellery is modest but refined: a medium-length pearl necklace with a single emerald pendant, matching pearl earrings, a small gold nose ring, thin gold bangles on both wrists and one emerald-studded ring on her right hand. She wears simple pointed tan leather Mughal mojari shoes with subtle green embroidery on the toes. In her right hand she delicately holds a circular silver Mughal coin in a slim gold rim, its face turned outward, while her left arm holds a small flat wooden writing board close to her side, emphasizing her authority; use soft pastel rose, off-white, gold, emerald green and tan as dominant colours, and present her in neutral poses from front, side and back to clearly show face, hair arrangement, garments, jewellery and coin prop.
